title: Install keeps each tier's model as the host's own setting
situation: The architect restated the concepts as name and differentia and cut implementation from them; this behaviour, which the concepts carried before, is recorded here so it stays bound.
decision: Install binds the model each tier and persona model role runs on in the host's own settings, keeping a binding the host already holds, and names every tier left unbound as the operator's next step; it never chooses a model in the operator's place.
consequences: Which model a tier runs on stays the operator's choice and the host's setting, surviving upgrades.
